about: The operating-system releases CelikPanel supports (D-038 §17), from docs/DISTRO-SUPPORT.md, the release evidence in docs/RESILIENCE-CONTRACT.md and the installer's platform detection. tested: every release candidate is run on it; accepted: CelikPanel installs and runs, but release candidates are not run on it; development: a rolling release used for development, supported as it is today; preview: detected, installation is refused. A release that is not listed has not been checked. Moving from one release to the next is the owner's step: CelikPanel never starts it.

releases.name: Red Hat Enterprise Linux 9 and AlmaLinux / Rocky Linux 9
